bullets.text: Delivered and maintained 2 production mobile applications (Ambak Yoddha and Ambak Saathi) in collaboration with backend, product, and QA teams.
Migrated applications from React Native Community CLI to Expo SDK 52, resolving deprecated module crashes, animation regressions, and bottom sheet scroll issues post-migration.
Built the entire Yoddha Home dashboard — check-in/checkout, today's tasks, attendance, performance, meetings, and My Partner modules — coordinating with backend and production teams.
Revamped the Task List screen with a Reanimated calendar strip, date-range bottom sheet, quick filters with scroll-aware auto-hide, inline task actions, and CSV export for selected date ranges.
Revamped critical check-in/checkout flow (AMB-1927), reducing API payload size and restructuring screens to remove redundant data dependencies.

Integrated TransUnion CIBIL credit checks on Saathi — credential input, WebView report, credit score display, dynamic lead widgets, and screenshot blocking on sensitive screens; handled 15+ API response cases.
Built a deep-linkable PST/PET task status management screen with PagerView tabs, dynamic form fields for reschedule/reassign/out-of-geo/not-interested flows.
Implemented FCM push notifications with deep linking; migrated dynamic linking from Firebase Dynamic Links to native Intent Filters (Android) and equivalent iOS handling.
Created a reusable native gallery component replacing custom image-upload screens across both apps, supporting single/multi-image selection.
Migrated state management from AsyncStorage to Redux for visit types and auto-checkout flows, improving consistency across sessions.
Introduced Stallion OTA code push with a custom script for per-app, per-OS deployments and release notes — reducing QA turnaround on minor fixes.
Reconfigured Fastlane to validate credentials upfront, preventing late-stage distribution failures; added Firebase Analytics events across both apps for live bug debugging.
Set up Fastlane CI/CD pipelines and Firebase Crashlytics for monitoring and production issue diagnosis.

activities: Company, product, and service onboarding with mentor/buddy assignment
Shadowing business managers to understand product and target audience
Dummy React Native + TypeScript project to learn app structure
